about_the_game:
Experience "a night of overtime you’ve grown accustomed to" in this ultra-short horror game.
But unlike the usual grind, the entire office tonight feels…off, ominous and Strange.
Your coworkers are nowhere to be found. The lights are dim. And something — or someone — unknown is lurking.
Can you make it until the end of your shift?

Overtime Syndrome – A Night Shift Story is a free, ultra-short horror game.

In this game, you take on the role of Max, an overworked corporate drone stuck on yet another late-night shift — only this time, something’s not quite right. Strange and unsettling events begin to unfold. As Max, you’ll try to finish your work and make it through the night… hopefully alive.

First-Person Horror

Experience the night shift from Max’s own eyes.
Control Max as you complete tasks, collect items, and follow mysterious leads in the hope of leaving work early — or at least leaving alive.

Uncover the Company’s Secrets

This decades-old company has a story of its own.
In this game, piece together the background of the company, uncover the hidden truth behind its decaying office, and discover the cause of the strange events you’re experiencing.

Your Phone is Your Lifeline

Who carries a old flashlight everywhere?
It’s 2025 — everybody has a smartphone! And when it comes to lighting your way, your phone’s flashlight will be your best friend.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1080 / RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible soundcard
  • Additional Notes: Playable on medium to low settings
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i9-10900K or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 or AMD Radeon RX 6900 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card with latest drivers
  • Additional Notes: Smooth performance on high settings

short_description: Experience “just another late night shift at the office” in this ultra-short horror game. Somehow this night, the whole office is filled with an eerie, unsettling atmosphere. Missing coworkers, dim lights, and a mysterious presence known only as “it”... Will you make it to the end of your shift?
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
